Name: Wanderer Scaramouche (Project Genshin Farmer Preset) - Fashion Sense (FS)
Author: Arknir27
Description:
[i][size=3]"I'm a new soul
I came to this strange world
Hoping I could learn a bit about how to give and take
But since I came here
Felt the joy and the fear
Finding myself making every possible mistake"  --Yael Naim[/size]

[/i][left][size=3]Play as the Wanderer from Genshin Impact. Commissioned by -Xanthos- as part of my Project Genshin Overhaul. Requires PeacefulEnd's framework, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]. Special thanks to PeacefulEnd.
[/size]

[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/994361829675507732/Fashion_Sense.png[/img][/center]

[size=3]Dress up in the unique Wanderer attire using the Hand Mirror.
Also includes hairstyle, hat, animated accessory, robes, shorts, and sandals. 
Hairstyle has a static version, as well as an editable color version.
